ravi: Quick sync: draft tactical plan to migrate tenants off pinned models with minimal churn.
maria: high level ok. what are the concrete gates?
ravi: propose: shadow -> canary -> opt-in wave -> full. gating: correctness delta <= 0.5% on tenant golden set, p95 latency +<=30ms, cost +<=10%, zero new safety hits.
kevin: add per-tenant sampling and a global budget cap to avoid cost surprises.
maria: UX needs: console toggle, sampling slider, export of pinned-exceptions.
kevin: ops: add route-override API and emergency rollback that flips routing within 30m.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: pipeline created project/model-migrations/1749001111-pipeline
ravi: owners: golden prompts (maria), nightly diff job (kevin), console work (maria), routing API (kevin). I'll draft short RFC after triage.
maria: i'll prep comms + FAQ for legal pins.
kevin: will stub dashboard alerts: mismatch_rate pager >0.5%, ticket >0.1%.
